documents.label: Valid Tax Clearance Certificate
documents.source_quote: 1. A valid Tax Clearance Certificate issued by the South African Revenue Services. Tenderers also to provide Transnet with a TCS PIN to verify Tenderers compliance status.

documents.label: Valid B-BBEE Certificate or Sworn Affidavit
documents.source_quote: 2. A valid B-BBEE Certificate from a Verification Agency accredited by the South African Accreditation System [SANAS], or a sworn affidavit confirming annual turnover and level of black ownership in case of all EMEs and QSEs with 51% black ownership or more together with the tender;

documents.label: Proof of registration on Central Supplier Database
documents.source_quote: 3. Proof of registration on the Central Supplier Database;

documents.label: Letter of Good Standing with Workmen's compensation fund
documents.source_quote: 4. Letter of Good Standing with the Workmen’s compensation fund by the tendering entity or separate Letters of Good Standing from all members of a newly constituted JV.

documents.label: Annex G Compulsory Enterprise Questionnaire
documents.source_quote: 5. A fully completed Annex G Compulsory Enterprise Questionnaire

documents.label: Certificate of Attendance at Compulsory Tender Clarification Meeting T2.2-01
documents.source_quote: Certificate of Attendance in the form set out in the Returnable Schedule T2.2-01 hereto must be completed and submitted with your Tender as proof of attendance is required for a compulsory site meeting and/or tender briefing.
